content.title: Fix: --branch double directory + BRANCH_CONFLICT
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/configurable-branch-spec.md
Validation: mpfm9ixr9i (comment mpfn2j3744)

Two critical bugs found in the --branch implementation:

BUG 1: Double directory creation (BLOCKER)
When running agt init --branch custom, BOTH directories are created: .agentrack/ (stale, regular dir) and .custom/ (proper worktree). Root cause: tracker init runs BEFORE branch/dir params are applied. Fix: pass custom dir path to tracker init from the start.

BUG 2: Missing BRANCH_CONFLICT detection
Branch with non-agentrack data is silently overwritten. Should throw BRANCH_CONFLICT. Fix: check branch exists and validate content.

Minor fixes (same pass):
1. Slash rejection should use spec-specific message
2. Default init should NOT write branch field to config.json
3. Rebuild dist after fixing (bun run build)

Verification:
1. agt init --branch custom creates ONLY .custom/ (no .agentrack/)
2. Pre-existing non-agentrack branch triggers BRANCH_CONFLICT
3. Default init omits branch field from config
4. Slash in name gives slash-specific error message
